title: 第3章  老树开花，心魔誓约
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
罗帐之内，春色无边。
李寒山如同野兽一般，丝毫不懂得怜香惜玉。
花弄影秀眉轻蹙，紧咬着唇。
旋即，她的玉臂攀上李寒山的脖子，动作却莫名带着几分生涩。
采补之法，已然运转。
李寒山浑身一颤，沉淀百年的先天纯阳之气倾泄而出。
“不愧是先天纯阳圣体，哪怕老了，这底蕴也远非那些凡夫俗子可比......”
花弄影美眸中掠过一抹狂热。
这先天纯阳之气，着实是大补之物，所过之处，经脉泛起一阵酥暖，原本驳杂的灵力变得精纯起来，就连那久无动静的瓶颈，也有了松动迹象。
只要将这老头的纯阳之气榨个干净，便可突破瓶颈，冲击那门秘法的下一层，甚至可以借此筑基！
“这阳册，果然神奇。”
李寒山状若疯狂，心底却是一片清明。
阳册运转后，体内悄然出现了一个缓缓旋转的漩涡，所有纯阳之气都需要从这个漩涡出去，由此来抵挡花弄影的采补。
李寒山甚至可以让花弄影一点都吸不到，可那样一来，花弄影必会起疑，所以他仅仅控制了纯阳之气被吸走的速度。
伴随着漩涡旋转，千丝万缕的能量流入李寒山的身体，这些能量，正是漩涡从花弄影体内悄无声息反吸过来的。
李寒山并没有轻举妄动，默默积攒着能量。
一柱香之后，他体内的能量已然足够充盈，花弄影仍沉浸在采补的畅快之中，没有任何的察觉。
“可以开脉了！”
李寒山不再犹豫，调动这些能量，依照梦中洛璃手把手为他模拟的路线，沿着自己的周身经脉冲去。
是的，他要开脉！

尽管有梦中的经验，可李寒山身子骨太老，开脉的过程，仍然凶险万分。
好在这股吸来的能量异常寻常的精纯，让李寒山在尝试了十多次后，终于，成功将灵脉冲开！
“轰！”
伴随着体内的闷鸣，一个新世界的大门，对着李寒山
有了灵脉，从此便不再是凡人！可以踏上修行之路了！
“咦？”
花弄影察觉到了不对劲，睁开迷离眼眸。
见状，李寒山不敢表露出丝毫的异常，仍是勤耕不辍，暗地里却在留意花弄影的反应。
“开脉？”
花弄影察觉到了李寒山的异常，愣了一下：“圣体初破，竟有此奇效？！”
随即，她轻笑嫣然：“没想到啊，你这老树居然真的开花了，若你再年轻个二十岁，本仙子说不定还会留你一命。”
李寒山闻言，眼中闪过一丝厉色。
计划追不上变化，李寒山的百岁高龄，哪怕开脉也让花弄影看不到希望，仍要杀鸡取卵，将他一次性吃干抹净！
“这可是你逼我的！”
李寒山心一横，决定动用最后一招，跟这妖女拼了。
但现在显然不是好的时机，所以李寒山仍然佯装被药力控制，还悄然放松了对纯阳之气的控制，这让花弄影吸到的纯阳之气倍增！
花弄影以为是李寒山开脉后的变化，纤细如玉的手指拂过李寒山的脸：“可惜呢，你太老了，宗门考核又近在眼前......”
嘴上说着可惜，她的汲取力度却是猛然加大。
“成了，要成了......”
花弄影容颜明艳，面露兴奋，她要突破了！

“就是现在！”
李寒山看到了机会。
生死成败，在此一举！
下一秒，李寒山体内的无形漩涡骤然变大，旋转的速度快了十倍不止，但不是朝一个方向旋转，而是快速的来回旋转。
随着漩涡的变化，那些被花弄影吸入了体内的纯阳之气，连同她自身的灵力俨若发生了暴动一般，在花弄影的体内横冲直撞。
这便是李寒山的高明之处，若是反吸，花弄影自然吸不过他，但花弄影可以选择直接杀了他。
像现在这样，才是正解。
“啊！！！”
花弄影的尖叫声差点震破李寒山的耳膜，李寒山猛的抱住她，双手死死钳住她的双臂，不让她挣脱。
“是你！！！老东西！我要杀了......噗！”
花弄影话才说到一半，便是一口鲜血溢出，眼底更是一片通红。
要知道，她正处于突破的关键时期，一点闪失都容不得，哪里经得起李寒山这样搞！
她手掐法决，却被李寒山将她的手指狠狠捉住，根本不给她施展术法的机会；她想要震荡灵力，将李寒山震开，却因为体内力量混乱难以做到。
所以，花弄影突然发现，她想要摆脱李寒山这个百岁老头子，唯一的办法竟是与他拼体力。
她虽是修仙者，终究只有炼气，体质不比凡人强多少，在双手被制又受了内伤的情况下，哪里挣脱得了！
“噗！”一番挣扎下来，花弄影又是一口血喷出，绝色容颜上再无半分傲气，只剩狼狈。
若是平时，李寒山这一招的杀伤力远没有这么大，但谁让花弄影选在这时候突破呢？
花弄影慌了，若李寒山继续下去，她非死即残，所以她当即软了语气，向李寒山求饶：
“停下，快停下，你要什么，我都答应你......”
“我放你离开，给你一千......三千灵石，我只剩这么多了！”

“功法、丹药、法宝，我全部给你！”
花弄影不断加码，但李寒山面沉如水，丝毫不为所动。
双方实力差距太大，花弄影只需缓过一口气来，动动手指头都能杀了他，身为妖女，她的承诺说撕就撕，简直是嘴上抹石灰——白说，没有丝毫可信度。
花弄影见李寒山铁了心要置她于死地，语气骤然变冷：“再不停手，老娘便是拼着经脉尽断、修为尽废，也定要拉着你同归于尽！！”
李寒山冷冷道：“一命换一命，我赚了！”
花弄影一滞，是啊，李寒山这条贱命值多少钱，她可是如花似玉的合仙宗仙子，内门天骄，前途一片光明，这笔买卖怎么看都不划算。
“噗......”
正准备说话，体内又是一阵翻江倒海，冲击瓶颈的反噬来了，花弄影喷出一大口血。
她心头一紧，彻底慌了神，急忙说道：“我储物戒里有一纸心魔誓约！签下此约，一旦反悔必遭心魔噬体、魂飞魄散，我愿以此立誓，今后做你的女奴，任你差遣，绝无半分异心！”
“心魔誓约？”
李寒山心中一动，面上却是不动声色：“我怎知那誓约是真是假？”
花弄影急道：“誓约一成，真假自见分晓。那是我费尽周折才弄到手的，本是留着寻个极品炉鼎用的！”
李寒山沉吟片刻，徐徐问道：“储物戒在哪里？”
“就在我左手食指上。”花弄影见李寒山语气松动，急忙道，“你放开我，我拿给你。”
李寒山冷冷一笑：“当我三岁小孩？你告诉我怎么取，我自己来。”
花弄影无奈：“你打不开.....罢了，这戒指本就有所损坏，你把它毁掉吧！”
李寒山将她两只手捉在一起，用衣服绑上后，再将她的储物戒取下，塞入花弄影嘴里，冷声道：“咬！”
花弄影只得用力一咬，将储物戒咬破，里面的东西掉落了一地。
有灵石，丹药，玉简，衣裙，武器，以及一张黑色的纸。
“那就是心魔誓约！”

花弄影道。
content_en:
Inside the tent, the spring scenery is boundless.
Li Hanshan is like a wild beast, not knowing how to show mercy at all.
Hua Nongying frowned lightly and bit her lip.
Immediately, her jade arms climbed up to Li Hanshan's neck, but her movements were inexplicably a little jerky.
The method of collecting and supplementing is already in operation.
Li Hanshan trembled all over, and the innate pure Yang energy that had accumulated for hundreds of years poured out.
"As expected of the Innate Pure Yang Holy Physique, even if I am old, my heritage is far beyond those of ordinary people..."
A flash of enthusiasm flashed across Hua Nongying's beautiful eyes.
This innate pure Yang Qi is really a great tonic. Wherever it passes, the meridians will feel warm, and the originally mixed spiritual energy will become pure. Even the bottleneck that has been silent for a long time is showing signs of loosening.
As long as the old man's pure Yang Qi is squeezed out, he can break through the bottleneck, hit the next level of the secret method, and even build a foundation with it!
"This Yang Book is indeed magical."
Li Hanshan looked crazy, but his heart was clear.
After the Yang book was running, a slowly rotating vortex quietly appeared in the body. All the pure Yang energy needed to escape from this vortex to resist Hua Nongying's harvesting.
Li Hanshan could even prevent Hua Nongying from absorbing it at all, but in that case, Hua Nongying would definitely become suspicious, so he only controlled the speed at which the pure Yang energy was sucked away.
As the vortex rotated, countless strands of energy flowed into Li Hanshan's body. These energies were quietly sucked back from Hua Nongying's body by the vortex.
Li Hanshan did not act rashly and silently accumulated energy.
After one stick of incense, the energy in his body was already sufficient, and Hua Nongying was still immersed in the pleasure of collecting the tonic without any notice.
"It's time to take your pulse!"
Li Hanshan no longer hesitated, mobilized these energies, and pulsed along his own meridians according to the route Luo Li simulated for him step by step in the dream.
Yes, he wants to open his pulse!
Despite the experience in the dream, Li Hanshan's body was too old, and the process of opening his pulse was still extremely dangerous.
Fortunately, the energy absorbed was unusually pure, so Li Hanshan finally succeeded in opening the spiritual pulse after trying more than ten times!
"Boom!"
Along with the muffled sound in his body, the door of a new world opened to Li Hanshan
With spiritual veins, you will no longer be a mortal! You can now embark on the path of spiritual practice!
"Huh?"
Hua Nongying noticed something was wrong and opened her blurred eyes.
Seeing this, Li Hanshan did not dare to show any abnormality, but continued to work hard, secretly paying attention to Hua Nongying's reaction.
"Open the pulse?"
Hua Nongying noticed Li Hanshan's abnormality and was stunned for a moment: "The first break of the holy body can have such a miraculous effect?!"
Then, she chuckled sweetly: "I didn't expect that your old tree would actually bloom. If you were twenty years younger, I might have spared your life."
When Li Hanshan heard this, a stern look flashed in his eyes.
The plan cannot keep up with the changes. Li Hanshan is a hundred years old. Even if his pulse is opened, Hua Nongying has no hope. She still wants to kill the goose to get the eggs and eat him up all at once!
"You forced me to do this!"
Li Hanshan was heartbroken and decided to use his last resort to fight this witch.
But now is obviously not a good time, so Li Hanshan still pretends to be controlled by the medicine, and quietly relaxes his control on the pure Yang energy, which doubles the amount of pure Yang energy that Hua Nongying absorbs!
Hua Nongying thought it was the change after Li Hanshan opened his veins, and brushed his slender jade-like fingers over Li Hanshan's face: "What a pity, you are too old, and the sect's examination is just around the corner..."
She said it was a pity, but the intensity of her absorption suddenly increased.
"It's done, it's going to be done..."
Hua Nongying's face is bright and excited, she is about to break through!
"Now!"
Li Hanshan saw an opportunity.
Life and death, success or failure, all depend on this!
The next second, the invisible vortex in Li Hanshan's body suddenly grew larger, and the speed of rotation was more than ten times faster, butInstead of spinning in one direction, it spins back and forth quickly.
As the vortex changed, the pure Yang energy that Hua Nongying had absorbed into her body, together with her own spiritual power, seemed to have gone into riot, running rampant in Hua Nongying's body.
This is the brilliance of Li Hanshan. If he is sucked back, Hua Nongying will naturally not be able to suck him in, but Hua Nongying can choose to kill him directly.
The way it is now is the right answer.
"Ah!!!"
Hua Nongying's scream almost broke Li Hanshan's eardrums. Li Hanshan hugged her fiercely, clamping his hands tightly on her arms to prevent her from breaking free.
"It's you!!! Old man! I'm going to kill...poof!"
Halfway through Hua Nongying's words, a mouthful of blood spilled out, and her eyes became even redder.
You know, she is in a critical period of breakthrough, and she cannot tolerate any mistakes. How can she withstand Li Hanshan's behavior!
She pinched the spell with her hand, but Li Hanshan grabbed her fingers tightly, not giving her a chance to use the spell. She wanted to shock her spiritual power and shake Li Hanshan away, but she couldn't do it because of the chaos in her body.
Therefore, Hua Nongying suddenly discovered that the only way she could get rid of Li Hanshan, a hundred-year-old man, was to compete with him physically.
Although she was a cultivator, she could only refine her Qi, and her physique was not much stronger than that of a mortal. With her hands restrained and internal injuries, how could she break free!
"Poof!" After struggling, Hua Nongying spurted out another mouthful of blood. There was no trace of pride on her stunning face, only embarrassment remained.
Normally, the lethality of Li Hanshan's move would not be so great, but who allowed Hua Nong Yingxuan to break through at this time?
Hua Nongying panicked. If Li Hanshan continued, she would either die or be disabled, so she immediately softened her tone and begged Li Hanshan for mercy:
"Stop, stop quickly, whatever you want, I will promise you..."
"I'll let you go and give you one thousand...three thousand spirit stones. This is all I have left!"
"Kung Fu, elixirs, magic weapons, I'll give them all to you!"
Hua Nongying kept adding more money, but Li Hanshan's face was as heavy as water and he remained unmoved.
The gap in strength between the two sides was so great that Hua Nongying could kill him with just a few clicks of her fingers as long as she took a breath. As a witch, her promise was torn up at the drop of a hat. It was like putting lime on her lips - she said it in vain and had no credibility at all.
Seeing that Li Hanshan was determined to kill her, Hua Nongying's tone suddenly turned cold: "If you don't stop, I will drag you to death together even if my meridians are cut off and your cultivation is ruined!!"
Li Hanshan said coldly: "One life for another, I earned it!"
Hua Nong's shadow froze, yes, how much is Li Hanshan's life worth? She is a fairy from the Hexian Sect who is as beautiful as a jade, a genius in the inner sect, and has a bright future. This deal is not a good deal no matter how you look at it.
"Pfft..."
Just as he was about to speak, his body was overturned again, and the backlash that hit the bottleneck came, and Hua Nongying spurted out a large mouthful of blood.
Her heart tightened, she was completely panicked, and she hurriedly said: "There is a piece of inner demon oath in my storage ring! If you sign this agreement, if you go back on it, you will be eaten by the inner demon and your soul will be scattered. I am willing to swear by this that I will be your slave girl from now on, and I will do whatever you want without any objection!"
"Inner Demon Pledge?"
Li Hanshan's heart moved, but his face remained calm: "How do I know whether that oath is true or false?"
Hua Nongying said anxiously: "The oath is 10%, and you will know whether it is true or not. I got it after a lot of hard work. I originally kept it to find a top-quality furnace!"
Li Hanshan pondered for a moment and asked slowly: "Where is the storage ring?"
"It's on my left index finger." Hua Nongying saw Li Hanshan's tone relaxed and said hurriedly, "Let me go and I'll give it to you."
Li Hanshan smiled coldly: "You think I'm a three-year-old? You tell me how to get it, and I'll do it myself."
Hua Nongying was helpless: "You can't open it...that's all. This ring is already damaged. Just destroy it!"
LiHan Shan caught her two hands together, tied them with clothes, then took off her storage ring, stuffed it into Hua Nongying's mouth, and said coldly: "Bite!"
Hua Nongying had no choice but to bite hard and broke the storage ring, and the contents fell to the floor.
There are spiritual stones, elixirs, jade slips, clothes, weapons, and a piece of black paper.
"That's the Inner Demon Pledge!"
Hua Nongying said.
